rules: only accepted observations at or before requested session are eligible
optional as_of boundary further restricts the visible prefix
as_of earlier than session_date returns AS_OF_VIOLATION
future observations and future revisions are not consumed
future event knowledge is filtered from bounded reference requests
walk-forward consumer may use only evidence whose as_of is no later than decision point
e1_future_event_invariance: NOT_A_LOOKAHEAD_GATE; event-aware behavior intentionally consumes explicit later event knowledge
